fullDesc: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, Michael Phelps won eight gold medals, breaking Mark Spitz's record of seven from 1972. Over his career he collected 23 Olympic golds, more than any other athlete.
realFacts: One win came by just 0.01 seconds in the 100m butterfly
He retired with 28 Olympic medals in total
He swam in five Olympic Games
He has spoken openly about mental health
